team_choice: Two teams worked on this ticket independently: team 1, PR {first}; team 2, PR {second}. To choose, write a line ‘Team 1’ or ‘Team 2’ on the ticket, then move it to ‘{go_state}’. Only your choice ships; the other PR closes.
missing_salt: Missing committed [guard] salt in the project configuration; add [guard] salt = <random value> to .cleared/agents.conf and commit it.
decision_diff: Changes to docs/decisions.md (removed lines start with -, added lines with +):

merge_queue: Shipping PR #{pr} is queued ({reason}). It will retry automatically with the same checks; no action is needed.
rollback_done: Cleared removed the release of {title} at {at}. Merge {merge} was reverted by {revert}. Reason: {reason}. Please inspect the failed release and its artifacts.
rollback_migrations_blocked: Release health failed for {title}: {reason}. Cleared did not roll back because this merge touches a declared database migration. Please inspect it now.
rollback_ambiguous_base: Release health failed for {title}: {reason}. Cleared did not roll back because the base branch moved to {head} after this release. Inspect the intervening commits now.
rollback_overlapping_release: Release health failed for {title}: {reason}. Cleared did not roll back because another release, {other}, went live close to it or was already failing (since {since}): the health check cannot tell which one broke it. Inspect both, then roll back the one at fault with cleared rollback.
rollback_health_still_failing: Health is still failing after rollback of {title}: {reason}. Cleared will not attempt another rollback. Please investigate now.
release_health_failing: Release health failed for {title}: {reason}. Automatic rollback is disabled; please inspect it now.
release_watch_failed: Cleared could not finish monitoring the release of {title}: {reason}. Inspect the release manually now.
rollback_failed: Cleared could not roll back the release of {title}: {reason}. Inspect the release manually now.
merge_dry_queue: It would wait in the queue: {reason}
